name: Gossip
overview: Scripture reveals that gossip involves spreading false reports and slander, as seen when Laban's sons accused Jacob of wrongdoing and when the men sent by Moses caused murmuring through slander. God commands His people not to bear false witness or raise false reports against their neighbors, emphasizing the sinfulness of talebearing and unrighteous testimony. These warnings highlight that gossip damages relationships and dishonors God’s name, urging believers to guard their words and avoid participating in such harmful speech.
